body.p: An electrically-insulating insulating cover (10) is for a bracket having a hollow structure. The bracket is attached to a tool attachment surface (2a) of a hollow arm member, and has a hollow hole (41a) that allows a wire body A to pass therethrough from a hollow portion (2d) in the arm member into an interior of the bracket through an opening on the tool attachment surface (2a). The insulating cover (10) is disposed in the interior of the bracket, and covers both bracket fixtures (5, 6) for fixing the bracket to the tool attachment surface (2a) and the hollow hole (41a).
